description: Full-Sized Keyboard with Num Pad: The Ki-Pad 2 Keyboard is an ideal choice for home and office work, offering a full-sized keyboard with a numeric pad for a familiar and efficient typing experience, making it perfect for professionals and individuals who regularly work with numbers. Dual-Colour Keys: Get a visually striking element in your keyboard with the dual color keys in Ki-Pad 2. The unique, and eye-catching Black and Grey color combination adds an appealing aesthetic touch, enhancing the overall look of your workstation. Shortcut Keys: Equipped with Multimedia Hotkeys, located on the top row of the keyboard. These keys provide shortcut access to various multimedia functions and other controls, like- mute, pause, volume control, and more. Additionally, it includes a dedicated key for the Indian Rupee symbol. Up to 10 Million Keystrokes: The keys on the Ki-Pad 2 Keyboard are designed to last up to 10 million keystrokes, ensuring long-lasting durability for regular home and office use.
